detailed_descriptions_html.en:
Ancient Wars: Sparta HD – Relive the Golden Age of Real-Time Strategy

Get ready to experience one of the most epic chapters in RTS history. Ancient Wars: Sparta HD is a fully remastered edition that brings the legendary battles of the ancient world to a whole new level. Lead the Spartans, Persians, and Egyptians through monumental wars that will decide the fate of civilization.

With enhanced HD graphics and refined gameplay, this remaster immerses you in tactical warfare where every decision can change history. Customize your armies, master advanced strategies, and unleash devastating abilities to crush your enemies.

🔥 Customize

Don’t inherit an army—forge your own.

  • Design and equip your troops with unique weapons and armor.

  • Capture enemy weapons and vehicles to turn them into your advantage.

  • Adapt your army in real time to counter enemy strategies.

⚔️ Conquer

It’s not just about winning… it’s about domination.

  • Scale walls, break gates, and overrun fortresses in monumental sieges.

  • Rule the seas with realistic naval battles: ram, board, and destroy.

  • Unleash advanced physics: deadly traps, chariots charging, and buildings collapsing under your might.

👑 Dominate

Every faction, a unique way of war. Every campaign, a legend to relive.

  • Command asymmetric civilizations: Spartans, Persians, and Egyptians with unique tactics, units, and playstyles.

  • Relive three historic campaigns: Sparta under Leonidas, Persia under Xerxes, and Egypt in rebellion.

  • Grow your heroes with an RPG-style leveling and skill system.

🏹 Compete

Do you have what it takes to be remembered as a true legend?

  • Enter the Sparta League and face players from around the world.

  • Challenge smarter and more adaptive AI than ever before.

  • Only the most skilled will rise to eternal glory.

🛠️ Create

Don’t just play history—write your own.

  • Design epic scenarios and battles with a powerful map editor.

  • Publish and download mods on Steam Workshop: a community of strategists building unforgettable experiences.

  • Expand your game beyond the original with limitless content.

⚔️ Forge your legend in the ancient world

Are you ready to lead your army to victory? Command the battlefield, defend your empire, and relive the most glorious moments of history with Ancient Wars: Sparta HD.

The fate of civilizations lies in your hands!
